The result is a live visualization of the electromagnetic environment surrounding Earth — and the rest of the solar system.</p>

OpenSpace renders magnetic field lines from the BATS-R-US model and shows how the magnetosphere responds dynamically to solar activity.</p>

          <div class="sw-facts-row">

  <div class="impact-cta-card">

<script>
(function () {
  var phenoms = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sw-phenom'));

  phenoms.forEach(function (phenom) {
    var panel = phenom.querySelector('.sw-panel');
    if (!panel) return;

    panel.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var isOpen = phenom.classList.contains('is-open');
      phenoms.forEach(function (p) {
        p.classList.remove('is-open');
        var pn = p.querySelector('.sw-panel');
        if (pn) pn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
      if (!isOpen) {
        phenom.classList.add('is-open');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });

    panel.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); panel.click(); }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
